title: Gastronomie / Lieferdienst

statements.note: Allergen and additive information must be reachable before the order for loose food sold online
Consumer prices are total prices including VAT

forbiddenWords.note: Using Bio/Öko requires certification and the control body code (DE-ÖKO-…) on the site; the gate cannot verify certification, hence WARN
Unauthorised health claims on food are a classic Abmahnung

manual: Gaststättenerlaubnis / Gewerbeanmeldung are not website duties but must exist
Allergen data must be accurate per dish — the gate only checks it is offered
Zusatzstoffe declared with the legal footnotes (Farbstoff, Konservierungsstoff, …) in the menu
pruefen: Kennzeichnung of Zusatzstoffe online: numbering vs. wording accepted by the local Lebensmittelüberwachung
Pfand for delivery packaging (VerpackG § 33 Mehrwegangebotspflicht since 2023) — wording on the ordering page
